movements.name: The oldest war
movements.note: Scale, and the rule the whole film runs on.

movements.name: The woman
movements.note: Who she is, what is being done to her, and what she does about it.

movements.name: What the letter has to cross
movements.note: The world between her and the answer.

c_yadava_people.name: The people of Mathurā, later of Dvārakā

props.lotus_garland: His lotus garland — the mark he is known by
props.wedding_garland: The garland lifted toward her window
props.chalk_marks: The chalk marks on the wall of Mathurā
props.painted_cloth: The painted cloth of the city in the sea
props.empty_place: The place laid for a brother who will not come
props.bows_rukmi: Rukmī's bows, broken one by one
props.razor_cloth: The cloth that binds him and the razor

shots.text: Dawn at Mathura's gate. A guard on the wall watches one unarmed man walk out alone; we stay behind him.
shots.houdini: Dawn haze through the gate; dust kicked up at his heels.

shots.text: His bare feet on the dust, from behind and below, walking toward the army.
shots.houdini: Dust puffs at each step.

shots.text: Thirty million Yavanas on the plain, banners to the horizon.
shots.houdini: Crowd of 220 agents to the horizon; banner cloth; haze.

shots.text: Kalayavana on his horse sees the man on foot and straightens.
shots.houdini: Horse breath, dust, banner flutter.

shots.text: Kālayavana gets off his horse in front of his army, takes off his sword and lets it fall in the dust.
shots.sound: Metal in dust. The drums stop dead.

shots.text: Kālayavana, close, looking at something walking toward him that he does not believe.

line.speaker: Kālayavana
line.en: No chariot. No bow. No shoes. This is the one they call a god?
line.te: రథం లేదు. విల్లు లేదు. చెప్పులు కూడా లేవు. వీడినా దేవుడంటున్నది?

shots.sound: Wind only, under the line.

shots.text: The Ocean of Milk from above: the mountain turning in white water, and two lines of figures running out to either horizon on one serpent.

line.speaker: Narration
line.en: They were made to pull the same rope, and not one of them could see what was holding the mountain up.
line.te: ఒకే తాడును లాగమన్నారు. ఆ కొండను పట్టుకున్నది ఏమిటో ఒక్కరికీ కనిపించలేదు.

shots.sound: A low bronze drone, one struck bell. No wind.
shots.houdini: Milk-ocean surface: viscous white FLIP, radial wake from the rod, foam ring. Hero sim.
shots.nuke: Haze pass over distance; the horizon lines never resolve into individual faces.
shots.staging: Mountain at world centre; the two lines run out to 2 km either side. Camera 90 m up, 300 m back from the rod.

shots.text: Blistered hands close on the serpent's body, knuckles white, the skin of the palm split.
shots.sound: Rope-creak of scale on scale; breath.
shots.houdini: Serpent scale displacement, sweat and blood micro-detail.
shots.nuke: Shallow depth; keep the far line soft.

shots.text: An Asura's face at the serpent's head, teeth set, smoke coughing past him.
shots.sound: A cough of smoke, deep.
shots.houdini: Smoke puff from the serpent's mouth, interactive with the face.
shots.nuke: Smoke element in front of frame; warm key from nothing visible.

shots.text: A black stain crosses the milk-white water faster than a man can run; fish turn white and float up behind it.

line.speaker: Narration
line.en: The first thing the ocean gave them was not the prize.

shots.sound: Everything else drops out. A hiss, very wide.
shots.houdini: Hālāhala spread: black dye advection across the FLIP surface, dead-fish scatter in the wake.
shots.nuke: Crush the blacks in the stain only; the milk stays at 0.9 and does not clip.

shots.text: Both armies drop the rope and run along the shore, gods and demons mixed together in the same direction.
shots.sound: Feet on wet shingle, no voices.
shots.houdini: Crowd run cycles, shared agent library; wet-sand footstrike.
shots.nuke: Motion blur long, 270-degree shutter on this one cut.

shots.text: The war of the gods: Indra raises the thunderbolt and the sky splits over the two armies.
shots.houdini: Lightning bolt, storm clouds, sea spray.

shots.text: Bali in the middle of his illusions; shapes that are not there fill the field around him.
shots.houdini: Illusion volumes: smoke that holds shapes, then tears.

shots.text: Deva and Asura lines crash together in the storm.
shots.houdini: Dust, spray, weapons sparks; crowd collision.

shots.text: Rahu sits in the line of drinkers. A flash of the disc, and his head is gone.
shots.houdini: Disc streak (light only, no wielder), head separation, light flare.

shots.text: Lakṣmī walks the line with the garland. The camera travels with her, past face after face, and she passes each one.

line.speaker: Narration
line.en: Everything in it was taken. One thing was given.

shots.sound: Her anklets, nothing else.
shots.houdini: Cloth and garland sim on a walking hero asset.
shots.nuke: Faces fall out of focus as she passes them.
shots.staging: She covers 12 m of the line in the shot; the camera dollies level with her at 3 m out.

shots.text: The garland lifts toward a pair of hands that never came forward — and the cut comes before the face.
shots.sound: Flowers. A bell, struck once, far away.
shots.houdini: Garland sim handover between two rigs.
shots.nuke: Frame cuts at the wrist. This is a hard rule, not a preference.
shots.staging: Her at 1.2 m from him, both hands inside a 1 m box. Nothing above the wrist is in the staging.

shots.text: A painted wall in the temple of Ambikā: a mountain, a serpent, a dark flood, a hand at a god's throat, and a goddess walking a line of suitors. A priest sweeps at the far end.
shots.sound: A broom. Temple quiet, with depth behind it.
shots.nuke: The mural is a matte painting projected on geometry; it must survive a 2.4s push.

shots.text: Rukmini's face, lit by nothing but the light off the painted wall. The first time the film looks at her.
shots.sound: Her breath. The broom stops.
shots.nuke: Bounce from the mural is the key. Warm, low, from frame left.

shots.text: Rukmī, close, closing the sale.

line.speaker: Rukmī
line.en: Chedi gives us a border. The cowherd would give us a cousin.
line.te: చేది మనకు సరిహద్దు ఇస్తుంది. ఆ గొల్లవాడు ఇచ్చేది ఒక బంధుత్వం మాత్రమే.

shots.sound: Clean dialogue, no room tone under it.

shots.text: She answers her brother without raising her voice, and the camera moves in on the last four words.

line.speaker: Rukmini
line.en: You can give away a kingdom, brother. Not a woman who has already chosen.
line.te: రాజ్యాన్ని ఇచ్చేయగలవు అన్నయ్యా. ఇప్పటికే నిర్ణయించుకున్న ఆడదాన్ని కాదు.

shots.sound: The push is silent; music has not started yet.

shots.text: Ink. The nib goes in, comes out loaded, and makes the first stroke of a letter to a king.
shots.sound: The nib. Bass flute enters here and runs to the end of the movement.
shots.houdini: Ink wet-surface shader, meniscus on the nib.
shots.nuke: Macro depth; the stroke is the only thing in focus in the trailer for 2 seconds.

shots.text: Her hand presses the seal into the wax, and holds it there a beat too long.
shots.sound: Wax, and the small sound of a decision.
shots.houdini: Wax deformation and cooling.

shots.text: Her face over the sealed letter. She says the line to nobody, and it is the thesis of the film.

line.speaker: Rukmini
line.en: They will say a woman was stolen. Let them. I am the one holding the pen.
line.te: ఒక ఆడపిల్లను ఎత్తుకుపోయారని అంటారు. అననివ్వండి — కలం పట్టుకున్నది నేనే.

shots.sound: Flute drops out under the line and comes back after it.

shots.text: One man on an enormous road at first light, and the country he has to cross opening out past him in every direction.
shots.sound: Wind at altitude. Percussion is still absent.
shots.houdini: Procedural terrain, scatter, dawn mist in the valleys.
shots.nuke: Atmospheric depth; he is four pixels tall and must still read.
shots.staging: The road runs to the horizon; he is 400 m from camera and 4 px tall. Terrain must carry to 8 km.

shots.text: Feet, then water: he crosses a river with the letter held above his head, dry.
shots.sound: Water at the waist. Breath.
shots.houdini: River FLIP with character interaction; wet-cloth transfer.
shots.nuke: Spray elements; keep the letter clean white in frame.

shots.text: Rukmi's rider closes on the Brahmin on the empty road.
shots.houdini: Horse dust trail.

shots.text: From the wall: a line of dust becomes tents, becomes banners, becomes a country of fires out to the horizon.
shots.sound: Percussion enters on the first frame of this shot. Frame drums, 92 BPM.
shots.houdini: Instanced camp at four LODs; 30,000 fires; dust haze.
shots.nuke: The horizon line is a matte painting handoff past 2 km.
shots.staging: Camp from the wall out to 4 km, fires from 600 m. Camera on the parapet, 30 m above the plain.

shots.text: The water-carrier stops counting, puts down his bucket, and makes one chalk mark on the wall because there is nothing else to do.
shots.sound: Chalk. The drums continue under it.

shots.text: Jarasandha, close, in front of his fires: 'Tell Mathura their king is ash.'

line.speaker: Jarasandha
line.en: Tell Mathurā their king is ash. Tell them who swept it.

shots.houdini: Camp fires and smoke behind him.

shots.text: Two radiant chariots come down out of the sky toward the plain.
shots.houdini: Glare volumes, light shafts, dust as they land.

shots.text: The conch; the glare swallows the figure on the chariot until only a silhouette is left.
shots.houdini: Glare that eats the silhouette; heat shimmer.

shots.text: Inside the dust: the plough comes through and sweeps the footsoldiers aside like a field being cleared.
shots.sound: Impact, low.
shots.houdini: Crowd ragdoll hand-off on contact; debris.
shots.nuke: Keep Balarama's face readable through the dust — he is not withheld.

shots.text: Close: Balarama's plough sweeps a rank of infantry off their feet.
shots.houdini: Bodies thrown (ragdoll RBD), dust.

shots.text: Arrows from outside the frame tear through a line of elephants.
shots.houdini: Arrow volley particles, impacts, elephants falling (rigged creatures).

shots.text: On the wall, a woman faints and the ones beside her do not catch her.
shots.sound: Cloth and stone.

shots.text: A chalk stroke on the wall.
shots.sound: Chalk, hard on the beat. The cut pattern from here is strictly on the drum.
shots.nuke: Match-frame the wall across all five inserts; only the marks and the light change.

shots.text: Night, torches coming at the wall.
shots.houdini: Torch instancing, 4,000 lights as cards.

shots.text: Fire arrows rain on the wall.
shots.houdini: Burning arrow particles with trails.

shots.text: A second chalk stroke beside the first.
An elephant charge hits the gate; the beam splits.
shots.houdini: Gate RBD fracture, splinters, dust.

shots.text: A siege tower burning against the wall.
shots.houdini: Pyro: tower fire, embers.

shots.text: The flood assault: water climbing the wall.
shots.houdini: FLIP flood against the wall, whitewater.

shots.text: A third stroke. The wall is getting crowded.
The camera pulls back off seventeen strokes. The carrier steps back with it, and this time there is no army on the horizon to follow it.

line.speaker: Jarasandha
line.en: Tell Mathurā their king is ash. Tell them who swept it.
line.te: మథురకు చెప్పండి — మీ రాజు బూడిద. ఆ బూడిదను ఊడ్చింది ఎవరో కూడా చెప్పండి.

shots.sound: Jarasandha's line lands over the pull-back; drums drop to half time under it.

shots.text: The chase: a barefoot man always one step out of reach, shot from behind and below, and never once from the front.
shots.sound: Two sets of feet, one of them not hurrying. Drums return at 132.
shots.houdini: Dust kick per footfall; garland sim.
shots.nuke: Framing cuts at the shoulder for the whole shot.

shots.text: The chase into the dark of the cave; Kalayavana a silhouette against the bright mouth.
shots.houdini: Dust in the light from the mouth.

shots.text: A kick. In the dark, a sleeper's eyes open.
shots.houdini: Dust falling from his body as he wakes.

shots.text: Fire: Kalayavana burns to ash where he stands.
shots.houdini: Pyro burn from the inside, ash dissolve, embers.

shots.text: The whole hillside alight, fire running up through the trees toward two figures near the top.
shots.sound: Fire at distance — a roar with no crackle in it.
shots.houdini: Hero pyro: wildfire up a slope, 2 km scale, with its own wind.
shots.nuke: Heat distortion over the ridge line.
shots.staging: Hill 2 km across, the two figures at the top ridge, camera 1.5 km out and 60 m up.

shots.text: Balarama looks down the mountain they have run out of. Behind him a figure stands in the smoke with his back to the fire — a silhouette, and nothing more than that.
shots.sound: Smoke, close. A beam goes somewhere below.
shots.houdini: Smoke interaction around two characters.
shots.nuke: Hard rule: the silhouette never resolves. Rim only, no fill, no face.

shots.text: They jump. The camera follows one silhouette against the flames and stops before the ground.
shots.sound: Air. Cut the sound one frame before the camera stops.
shots.houdini: Fire interaction on falling bodies.
shots.nuke: Speed ramp inside the shot; land on the stop.

shots.text: The first gate breaks the surface of the sea. Then a wall, then towers, then terraces of crystal and gold, and the water parts and settles around them as if they had always been there.
shots.sound: The full ensemble arrives here — brass and low strings, the only major-key moment in the trailer.
shots.houdini: The film's largest sim: city emergence, displaced water, sheeting runoff off every surface, whitewater at the walls.
shots.nuke: Wet-surface pass is a separate layer; the gold must not clip at the top.
shots.staging: City emerges 300 m off the shore, 900 m of frontage. Camera on the water at 18 m, craning to 40 m through the shot.

shots.text: The kings arrive in a column that does not end: escort after escort, banner after banner, filling the streets of Kuṇḍina.
shots.sound: Drums at full, with conches cutting across them.
shots.houdini: Crowd and horse instancing; banner cloth sim at three LODs.

shots.text: In the hall they swear it together and then one by one: if he comes for her, we fight him.
shots.sound: Many voices saying one thing.
shots.nuke: Firelight from below; this is the only low-angle in the movement.

shots.text: On the road outside, Balarama arrives with an army behind him and says what he has come for.

line.speaker: Balarama
line.en: You came for a bride. I came for the war that follows her.
line.te: నువ్వు పెళ్లికూతురి కోసం వచ్చావు. ఆమె వెనకాల వచ్చే యుద్ధం కోసం నేను వచ్చాను.

shots.sound: Clean line; drums drop out and come back on the cut.

shots.text: Rukmi swears before the kings.
His bow snaps: an arrow from nowhere.
shots.houdini: Bow fracture, splinters; the arrow is a streak only.

shots.text: A second bow, a third, then his shield, as his chariot runs.
shots.houdini: Shield RBD, road dust.

shots.text: Chariot lines collide in a wide. No bride, and no direction of escape.
shots.houdini: Dust, collisions, horses (rigged).

shots.text: Wheels, dust, a horse going down.
shots.houdini: Wheel fracture, horse fall, dust.

shots.text: A ring of soldiers around one woman, moving down a road lined with people, toward a temple door at the end of it.
shots.sound: Conches, drums, bards — all of it diegetic and all of it slightly too loud.
shots.houdini: Crowd on both sides; flower scatter; dust.
shots.nuke: The temple door is the only still point in the frame.
shots.staging: Road 120 m from palace gate to temple step, crowd both sides, temple door dead centre at the end.

shots.text: A soldier's eyes go along the roofline and the road, looking for a man nobody here has seen.
She comes out of the temple door with her friends behind her and stops on the threshold.
shots.sound: Sound drops away across this cut, not on it.
shots.nuke: Interior-to-exterior exposure shift held in-camera.

shots.text: She walks out among the kings who came for her, and goes past them as if they were furniture. One of them drops a cup.
shots.sound: The cup is the only sound.
shots.houdini: Rigid-body on the cup; wine.
shots.nuke: Faces in the rank go soft as she passes — the inverse of T-03.

shots.text: A sound off screen, wheels or hooves, and every king turns his head toward it.
Her eyes are down on the stones. Then they lift.
shots.sound: Nothing yet.
